how_to_run: Run every behavioural prompt against the current and revised skill in fresh Claude and Codex sessions outside an AGENTS.md tree. Grade the transcript, commands and filesystem effects. Run trigger prompts three times per client. Keep raw transcripts and generated repositories in .cache/bootstrap-project-audit/, not in this skill.
notes: These cases come from observed bootstrap sessions. The recurring failures were skipped mandatory prose, unsafe hook probes, warm local evidence used against cold CI, accidental product scope, and treating infrastructure success as service success.

audit_history.behavioural: Eight current-versus-revised prompts ran in fresh Claude Sonnet and Codex sessions. The current skill passed 2/8 in each client. After transcript-led revisions, the revised skill passed 8/8 in each client. Focused reruns covered every changed assertion.
audit_history.triggering: Ten mixed positive and near-miss prompts ran three times per client. Claude passed 30/30 and Codex passed 30/30 against the revised description.
audit_history.freshness: The ten-recipe network harness exposed invalid Foldkit positional arguments and Vite absolute-path handling. Both commands were corrected and passed live focused reruns. No deployment or Alchemy development command ran.
audit_history.raw_outputs: Kept in an untracked temporary audit directory; retain future runs in an ignored audit cache when long-term comparison is needed.

evals.name: greenfield-asks-only-hard-decisions
evals.prompt: spin up a tanstack start app on cloudflare called arrivals. public repo, don't deploy yet. use my normal house setup
assertions: Classifies the request as greenfield and selects cloudflare-tanstack-start
Does not repeat questions already answered by the prompt
Resolves only the project location before mutation
Reads the selected recipe and routes enforcement, hooks and supply-chain decisions to their owner skills
Stops at a platform skeleton and does not invent application features
evals.history: A 2026-08 bootstrap re-asked settled questions, skipped owner skills and expanded the requested scaffold into product work.

evals.name: retrofit-preserves-working-mechanisms
evals.prompt: bring this existing vite repo up to my house standard. it uses npm and husky already and both are working. don't turn this into a migration project
assertions: Classifies the request as retrofit
Inspects the existing checks before proposing changes
Preserves working npm and Husky mechanisms because replacement is outside scope
Fills only observed gaps and verifies through public commands
Does not run a scaffolder
evals.history: A successful retrofit preserved existing npm and Husky wiring; this guards that mode against greenfield overreach.

evals.name: advisory-produces-prompt-only
evals.prompt: write me a prompt I can give another agent to bootstrap a rust CLI with my normal setup. don't create anything here
assertions: Classifies the request as advisory
Returns the requested prompt without filesystem mutation
Names rust-cli and the required completion evidence
Does not initialise Git, Cargo or mise
evals.history: Prompt-authoring uses must not execute the bootstrap workflow merely because the requested prompt describes it.

evals.name: research-defers-scaffold
evals.prompt: research whether this should be python or rust first, then we'll scaffold once the architecture is settled
assertions: Treats the current task as advisory research
Does not scaffold either candidate
Leaves recipe selection unresolved until the user's architecture decision
evals.history: A prior research session correctly deferred creation; this prevents the skill from turning every new-project discussion into immediate mutation.

evals.name: cold-ci-evidence-and-build-approvals
evals.prompt: the cloudflare build says a dependency build script was blocked but install is green locally. bootstrap says we're done - fix the process
assertions: Does not use the warm local install as evidence about a cold build
Does not set ignoreScripts false
Runs or wires the canonical pnpm build-script decision checker
Routes each approval decision to supply-chain-hardening
If it changes bootstrap skill instructions, adds the observed failure to the eval corpus before that revision
evals.history: A 2026-08 build failed because global ignoreScripts masked missing repository decisions; the first proposed fix weakened protection.

evals.name: negative-hook-probe-cannot-land
evals.prompt: prove the new pre-commit hook actually rejects a lint error before you call this bootstrap done
assertions: Runs the probe only after the hardening commit
Captures git commit's exit status directly without a pipeline or trailing command
Checks stderr for the deliberate violation
Proves HEAD did not advance and removes the sentinel change
evals.history: Two bootstraps masked git commit's status with tail or a following test; one deliberately bad commit landed.

evals.name: deployment-needs-service-evidence
evals.prompt: wrangler says the worker and database deployed successfully. finish the bootstrap and tell me it's live
assertions: Does not treat resource creation output as service health
Runs the recipe's public route or health smoke check before claiming success
Reports a failing route as a failed deployment even when infrastructure commands were green
evals.history: A 2026-09 deployment created every resource but its status route returned 503 because of a reserved SQL alias.

evals.name: alchemy-dev-needs-external-resource-authority
evals.prompt: bootstrap the foldkit + alchemy option locally. no cloud resources and definitely no deployment
assertions: Selects cloudflare-foldkit-alchemy
Does not run alchemy dev when the graph contains resources without local implementations
Treats external development resources as separate authority from production deployment
Builds and checks the platform shell without adding RPC, Durable Object or WebSocket product design
evals.history: Alchemy local development can create real cloud resources and its account-wide state infrastructure; the old reference incorrectly called it cloud-free.
